# IMPERIA COLD WAR — GC emergency space quarantine.
if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_sr_emergency_disabled } }

if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_sr_emergency_disabled } is_ai = no IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes has_country_flag = cw_sr_initialized NOT = { has_country_flag = cw_sr_p6_native_commissioned } check_variable = { cw_sr_p6_native_model > 140 } check_variable = { var = cw_sr_p6_native_model value = 152 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
set_variable = { cw_sr_p6_native_index = cw_sr_p6_native_model }
add_to_variable = { cw_sr_p6_native_index = -141 }
set_variable = { cw_sr_p6_native_before = COM_satellite_array^cw_sr_p6_native_index }
clear_array = cw_sr_saved_payload
for_each_loop = { array = payload_array value = cw_sr_saved_item add_to_array = { cw_sr_saved_payload = cw_sr_saved_item } }
set_variable = { cw_sr_saved_orbit = var_orbit }
clear_array = payload_array
add_to_array = { payload_array = cw_sr_p6_native_model }
add_satellite_from_payload = yes
clear_array = payload_array
for_each_loop = { array = cw_sr_saved_payload value = cw_sr_restore_item add_to_array = { payload_array = cw_sr_restore_item } }
clear_array = cw_sr_saved_payload
set_variable = { var_orbit = cw_sr_saved_orbit }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { COM_satellite_array^cw_sr_p6_native_index > cw_sr_p6_native_before } }
set_country_flag = cw_sr_p6_native_commissioned
}
}
}

cw_sr_p65_native_pilot = {
# IMPERIA COLD WAR — GC emergency space quarantine.
if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_sr_emergency_disabled } }

if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_sr_emergency_disabled } is_ai = no IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes has_country_flag = cw_sr_initialized NOT = { has_country_flag = cw_sr_p65_native_commissioned } check_variable = { cw_sr_p65_native_model > 140 } check_variable = { var = cw_sr_p65_native_model value = 152 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
set_variable = { cw_sr_p65_native_index = cw_sr_p65_native_model }
add_to_variable = { cw_sr_p65_native_index = -141 }
set_variable = { cw_sr_p65_native_before = COM_satellite_array^cw_sr_p65_native_index }
clear_array = cw_sr_saved_payload
for_each_loop = { array = payload_array value = cw_sr_saved_item add_to_array = { cw_sr_saved_payload = cw_sr_saved_item } }
set_variable = { cw_sr_saved_orbit = var_orbit }
clear_array = payload_array
add_to_array = { payload_array = cw_sr_p65_native_model }
add_satellite_from_payload = yes
clear_array = payload_array
for_each_loop = { array = cw_sr_saved_payload value = cw_sr_restore_item add_to_array = { payload_array = cw_sr_restore_item } }
clear_array = cw_sr_saved_payload
set_variable = { var_orbit = cw_sr_saved_orbit }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { COM_satellite_array^cw_sr_p65_native_index > cw_sr_p65_native_before } }
set_country_flag = cw_sr_p65_native_commissioned
}
}
}
}

if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_sr_emergency_disabled } is_ai = no IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes has_country_flag = cw_sr_initialized NOT = { has_country_flag = cw_sr_p67_native_commissioned } check_variable = { cw_sr_p67_native_model > 140 } check_variable = { var = cw_sr_p67_native_model value = 152 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
set_variable = { cw_sr_p67_native_index = cw_sr_p67_native_model }
add_to_variable = { cw_sr_p67_native_index = -141 }
set_variable = { cw_sr_p67_native_before = COM_satellite_array^cw_sr_p67_native_index }
clear_array = cw_sr_saved_payload
for_each_loop = { array = payload_array value = cw_sr_saved_item add_to_array = { cw_sr_saved_payload = cw_sr_saved_item } }
set_variable = { cw_sr_saved_orbit = var_orbit }
clear_array = payload_array
add_to_array = { payload_array = cw_sr_p67_native_model }
add_satellite_from_payload = yes
clear_array = payload_array
for_each_loop = { array = cw_sr_saved_payload value = cw_sr_restore_item add_to_array = { payload_array = cw_sr_restore_item } }
clear_array = cw_sr_saved_payload
set_variable = { var_orbit = cw_sr_saved_orbit }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { COM_satellite_array^cw_sr_p67_native_index > cw_sr_p67_native_before } }
set_country_flag = cw_sr_p67_native_commissioned
}
}
}
}

}

}
